whoWeAre.title: Who we are
paragraphs: Arculus Funds Management (GCI Australia AFSL 346034) is an Australian fixed income manager, operating since 2013. We manage over $1.2bn (AUD) across two retail unit trusts, wholesale strategies and private mandates for family offices, charities and wealth advisory groups.

The team has amassed more than a century's collective knowledge through several full market cycles, across fixed income, equities, derivatives and hybrids. That experience shapes a simple view: in fixed income, the money you don't lose matters more than the yield you chase.

philosophy.title: How we invest
items: No performance fee

We don’t take a performance fee, so we are capital preservation focused. All of our peers take performance fees that reward them for taking risk in an asset class where returns are driven by the coupon yield.
Absolute return

We are an absolute return manager. What this means is that we are benchmark unaware and will vary duration at different points in the economic cycle. In times of rising rates we are very low fixed duration and due to the systemic economic risk of the rate rises also currently low credit spread duration. When rates peak, we will increase duration and benefit from the capital gains in a falling rate environment.
Independent oversight

We don’t own the funds or administer them like other fund managers. The funds are monitored for mandate compliance by DDH Graham ($17bn FUM) and valued by SS&C. There are 4 eyes on every transaction: Custody - Administration - Investment Management and the Responsible Entity.
Australian issuers, AUD only

The investment universe for all our funds is Australian issuers only in AUD. What this means is that there is no currency risk, and regulatory risk changes are limited to Australia and bonds that are issued under Australian law. We do not employ leverage either directly or through the use of derivatives.
ESG
We have a strong and simple ESG approach that will deliver an ESG outcome that is easily explained.
No securitised or property exposure
We have no mandated exposure to the MBS, CMBS or ABS securities and no property loans or property developer exposures.
